Please solve this issue:

## Bug Description

NuttX lacks a kernel event group primitive. PR #12802 adds a new event API (nx_event_init, nx_event_post, nx_event_wait, nx_event_reset, nx_event_destroy) declared in include/nuttx/event.h and implemented in sched/event/. On the base kernel commit, event.h does not exist, so nxevent.c fails to compile.

  - ostest completes and exits with status 0

static void nxevent_yield(void)

static void nxevent_test_rule1(nxevent_t *event)
{
  int ret;

  /* Case 2.1: wait for nxevent_thread bringup

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, 0, 0), ~0);

  /* Case 2.3: post == ~0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  nxevent_post(event, ~0, 0);

  /* Case 2.4: post == 0, wait == ~0 */

  nxevent_yield();

  NXEVENT_TEST(nxevent_wait(event, ~0, 0), ~0);
